schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: Cron / time based — runs an agent or flow when the expression is due.

tag.title: Tag automations
tag.description: Runs with the final response when a turn in a session with the trigger tag finishes.

board.title: Board automations
board.description: Runs with card context when a kanban card is moved, created, or changed.

token.title: Token automations
token.description: Runs maintenance or cleanup when session or workspace token usage crosses a threshold.

phase.title: Trajectory phase automations
phase.description: Runs when a declared trajectory phase ends or starts; recipe watchers can also bind it.

trajectoryEnd.title: Trajectory-end automations
trajectoryEnd.description: Runs when a trajectory finishes (done, failed, or abandoned) for summaries, lessons, and docs.

flow.title: Flow-run automations
flow.description: Runs when an agent's flow run finishes (success, failure or a low grade) with the reply and run context; trigger nodes inside flows can also fire automations of any kind.

board.actionHint: Choose what happens when triggered: start the target agent or flow, archive the card, or move it without an LLM call.
board.priorityHint: Fire order among automations watching the same card change. Lower numbers run first.
board.exclusiveHint: This automation exclusively owns a matching card change and suppresses every other matching board automation.

token.thresholdHint: Fires whenever cumulative usage crosses another multiple of this interval (for example 100k, 200k). Tokens include input, output, and cache.

trajectory.phaseHint: Phase id from the recipe (plan, code, review…). Empty matches every phase.
trajectory.recipeHint: Only trajectories seeded from this recipe slug, without a version. Empty matches every trajectory.

flow.agentHint: Only this agent's flow runs. Empty matches every agent.
flow.maxGradeHint: Only runs the decision model (flow-grade authority) graded at or below this. With grading off nothing matches.

automationModal.archiveActionDescription: The archive action hides the card from the board; it needs no target agent, flow, or prompt.
automationModal.targetHint: The agent or flow to run when triggered.
automationModal.sessionHint: Open a new session for every trigger or continue one persistent session with its previous conversation.
automationModal.continueDescription: The agent sees the previous thread on every trigger, like a persistent cron job; no tag loop is seeded.
automationModal.maxIterationsHint: Must be between 1 and {{max}}. Zero (unlimited) is rejected because it risks an infinite loop; the server validates this range too.
automationModal.expiryHint: The automation will not trigger after this optional time.
automationModal.stuckTemplateHint: Fills the form with the stuck-session repairer. It starts a fixer after a tagged session repeatedly fails, then clears the stuck tag and counter after a successful repair. Choose a target agent before saving.
automationModal.stuckTemplateActive: template active: the fixer session starts without tags to prevent a loop
